OCP.identity_kind: operational alias and folio, not native ChatGPT conversation ID
OCP.repository_collision_check: limited to accessible repository scope; organization-wide uniqueness not asserted

rules_implemented: FT and FDT are equivalent terms for frente de trabajo.
OCP is the project repository folder for one FT; multiple FTs may exist in one repository.
A session receives a folio SES-AAAAMMDD-XXXXXXXX; each FT may have only one active session.
An active conflicting owner triggers Sam P037 and Metacanon §42: ask once for explicit transfer authorization, compare SHA/generation, read back.
The first cycle after retaking a FT reproduces the last persisted visible model output verbatim with provenance, or reports unavailable without reconstruction.
Metacanon §4 is mandatory in every cycle.
Review GOW at cycle start and close, without exception; manually inspect Sam cascade each cycle.
Normative MCP verification remains disabled and must not be claimed.
IPZ terminology and direct links to GOW, Metacanon §4 and Sam cascading principles are in GOW.
